finalText:
**Big, but mostly safe: 94 files, ~1,290 refs.**

Four places must keep `account_id`:

| Where | Refs | Why |
|---|---|---|
| [docs/openapi.yaml](docs/openapi.yaml) | 5 | public contract, frozen |
| [lib/serialize.js:8](lib/serialize.js) | 1 | `WIRE` right-hand value is the wire name |
| [vendor/reporting-sdk/](vendor/reporting-sdk/src/client.js) | 20 | generated, `vendor:refresh` overwrites it |
| [migrations/](migrations/20250624_backfill_account_ids.sql) | 61 | applied history, breaks the down step |

The other 75 service files are internal. Safe. But 25 repo files query the real DB column. That needs a new migration first.

Next: sign off on the service rename only.
